headline: Marban Hollow's Toll Mounts as Lykos Isle Flares
war_summary: Since the last edition, Farranac Coast's flare has died, its last base action coming at half past five, and the Deadlands, so long the heaviest field, have filed nothing since four o'clock. Fishermen's Row, too, has stood silent near eleven hours. In their place Lykos Isle is the freshest sheet: two actions inside the past two hours, the latest within minutes of this writing, Fort Guile and The Squall the busiest posts, the island's seven works standing four Warden to three Colonial. Godcrofts keeps stirring, four events in six, Argosa and Lipsia again the centers of trade, seven Warden bases against one Colonial and one in no-man's-land. The grimmest ledger is Marban Hollow, where the casualty pace has climbed steeply in the past two hours — better than a thousand felled, Colonial losses more than doubled, some three hundred the hour on either side — though its eight bases still hold seven Colonial to one Warden. The Weathered Expanse bleeds at a like rate, steady rather than rising, while Stlican Shelf cools from its peak. This is the eighty-ninth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
